lines.text: Your database just checked 1 million rows to find 1.
lines.spoken: Your database just checked 1 million rows to find 1.

lines.text: Without an index, that is the only way it can look.
lines.spoken: Without an index, that is the only way it can look.

lines.text: An index is a sorted copy of one column.
lines.spoken: An index is a sorted copy of one column.

lines.text: Sorted means you can throw away half the rows every step.
lines.spoken: Sorted means you can throw away half the rows every step.

lines.text: Start in the middle: too big, drop everything below.
lines.spoken: Start in the middle: too big, drop everything below.

lines.text: Too small, drop everything above, and repeat.
lines.spoken: Too small, drop everything above, and repeat.

lines.text: 20 of those halvings is enough for 1 million rows.
lines.spoken: 20 of those halvings is enough for 1 million rows.

lines.text: So the lookup gets instant. The writes do not.
lines.spoken: So the lookup gets instant. The writes do not.

lines.text: Every insert has to keep the sorted copy sorted.
lines.spoken: Every insert has to keep the sorted copy sorted.

lines.text: An index trades slower writes for a search that halves.
lines.spoken: An index trades slower writes for a search that halves.
